title: CONNECT-IP Tunnel Setup Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 tunnel setup and lifetime policy.
scope: This verification covers decoded target and ipproto variable validation, optional wildcard scope, malformed variable handling, DNS-before-reply gating for DNS targets, setup error rejection, Proxy-Status details, tunnel lifetime tied to request stream, assignment maintenance while open, inactivity teardown, and request-stream close when tearing down.
preconditions: RFC 9484 request policy helpers are trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused CONNECT-IP tunnel setup tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 tunnel setup artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0031-0040 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 tunnel setup and lifetime policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
